Think of it like a community driven, open-world choose your own adventure book. The QM tells the story and gives us choices on what to do next, and the players pick a choice or make their own choice.

The QM is the Quest Master, and in this case it looks like it's aptly named @Text_Adventure. He'll be telling the story and giving options for what the players can do. If no options are given, you're free to write your own in.

Who will get those replies? The first one? The most upvoated comment? Whoever the QM likes most? ,...

Or will there be a branched story?

On the sub it says the winning choice will be the most upvoated comment. Picking the most popular choice among the players is usually the best way to handle it. As for branched stories, those usually only happen if the players end up killing themselves and most people want to continue down another path. QMs usually don't run branches stories though, as players can easily get into the mindset of picking the stupid options knowing that they can start again.
